title: Four ARCS axioms (Clarity/Agency/MinSteps/Kairos)
essence: Every receipt scored against four constitutional axioms: clarity_before_curvature, agency_over_automation, minimum_steps_to_coherence, kairos_over_neuroticism — each YES/TENSION/NO.

title: Five-dimension instrument model (Alignment/Reliability/Coherence/Speed/Energy)
essence: Maps a SAGE receipt to five kinematic dimensions rendered as material states; axiom-alignment, phase-cancellation reliability, NCI coherence, velocity speed, somatic energy.

title: Four lose-the-room transcript patterns
essence: Four detectable pitch-failure patterns with plain-language fixes: too_academic, category_drift ('selling a religion'), no_benefit (features without stakes), jargon_density.

title: QUICKMOVE/PLAN/COURT mode inference from gate+NCI
essence: Decision mode inferred mechanically: no gate_pass=COURT, NCI>=85=QUICKMOVE, else PLAN; stage count scales with mode and decision type.

title: Freyja → Visceral Translator → Baldur → Witness Receipt
essence: Pre-verbal signal path: preserve UNDEFINED signal before language (Freyja), Baldur is orthogonal protection that pauses the pipeline into witness mode when processing would violate the field.

title: Odin → Tyr → Thor mid-stack (name/constrain/strike)
essence: Mid-stack arc: Odin names signal without collapsing it (NCI forms), Tyr runs constraint court (BAR/KKL/LAB/HC-IPCI), Thor strikes at Kairos Lock when NCI>=0.85; write-lock = Decision Receipt.

title: Ullr graduation — scaffolding decreases as fluency rises
essence: ROM invariant: ARCS must reduce visible scaffolding as practitioner internalizes the arc; no retention mechanic may treat genuine fluency (Ullr state) as churn — that is a NOTOMATION violation.

title: Baldur — some things cannot be instrumentalized
essence: Some interactions (relational, intimate, trust-constituted, grief) are harmed by the act of instrumentalizing; ARCS must know when NOT to run the instrument. No-go zone for extraction mechanics.

title: Freyja — the most important signal arrives before language
essence: Existing decision tools start too late, after the field is compressed into words; ARCS begins at the pre-verbal somatic field (Zone 1) to catch highest-signal data before compression.

title: Ullr — mastery is when the instrument disappears into the practitioner
essence: Highest form of mastery: user internalizes the field so the tool disappears into the craft; ARCS optimizes for time OUT of the app, not dependence. Ullr is not boredom-churn.

title: Witness Receipt format + integrity check
essence: Format for held (not processed) moments: Moment/Field, no True North, blank Note is correct; integrity check guards against a stalled decision masquerading as a held moment.

title: Decision Receipt template (Thor artifact)
essence: Full decision-record template: Question/Horizon/Stakes/Irreversibility, Court mode+verdict, True North (one sentence), write-lock, NCI self-grade target >=8.5; irreversibility>0.7 auto-triggers Court.

title: Graduation Receipt template (Ullr artifact)
essence: Records arc run internally with reduced scaffolding; Scaffolding-absent field is the differential; arc-integrity check is embedded Loki test against declaring graduation after a lucky skipped arc.

title: Receipts as proof + anti-hypocrisy clause
essence: ARCS uses auditable Decision Receipts as proof, not testimonials; a receipt-integrity brand must itself be receipted — illustrative claims stay labeled until a verified pilot case replaces them.

title: PLG gate hard rules (dark patterns = NOTOMATION violation)
essence: Six non-overridable onramp rules: no gate before value, no mid-flow gates, no guilt mechanics, no dark patterns, clean exit always, onramp cannot be a slot machine — enforced as NOTOMATION.

title: Five brand pillars — corridor not casino
essence: ARCS = examined-time instrument optimizing for time OUT of app; five pillars: agency-preserving, receipt-anchored, corridor-not-casino, earned pattern-recognition, self-aware about its own cost.

title: Field OS category — why ARCS != GPT/Claude
essence: Category = Field OS running beneath decisions, not on top; differentiator vs stateless LLMs is stateful RAM/ROM + Write-Lock + Constitutional Court that can block an identity-violating move.

title: Three simultaneous JTBD layers
essence: ARCS serves functional + emotional + social JTBD at once; tools that serve only functional feel like tools, all three feel like an OS; Kintsugi turns repeat mistakes to gold not scar.

title: PLG flywheel — receipts deepen the basin
essence: Six-step flywheel (compass→receipt→pattern→resume-card→ROM promotion→referral) increases cost of leaving via accumulated receipts and pattern intelligence, not lock-in.

title: DEWY macro — Dewey/Etymology/Wiki-links/Yours
essence: DEWY here is the 4th always-on tagging macro (Dewey-code classify, Etymology, Wiki-links, folksonomy) run AFTER outputs — distinct from v9's DEWY decision state-vector; defines ARCS Dewey code system.

title: v8.3 Transversal Canon — NCI grading + Kintsugi + source grades
essence: Domain-agnostic L0-L5 spine; NCI self-grade (Factual/Sources/Honesty/Action, target 88, never claim 95 without n>=5); Kintsugi auto-kills fabricated stats/false urgency; A-F source grades. NCI='Normalized Confidence Index'.

title: v8.5 Field OS — NOTOMATION + Diamond Protocol + objective function
essence: Field OS runtime: objective = maximize Semantic Velocity, minimize Cognitive Mass; NOTOMATION (tools scaffold never replace); Diamond Protocol = Triune Logic + Kairos; v9 ROM candidates on by default.

title: Operator-20 DEWY run (SYNTHETIC example)
essence: Fictional/synthetic DEWY decision-run demonstrating output shape (true_north, clarity_mode, folksonomy, dewey_codes); explicitly not real data.
